blurb: Matias Scalbi is an Argentine finance commentator based in Rosario who has been engaged with markets since age 16. He is associated with IEM (Invirtiendo el Mercado — Investing the Market), an Argentine financial education and analysis platform, and studied at Universidad Austral. His X presence focuses on quantitative investing ideas, systematic strategies, and accessible explanations of academic finance research, often translating award-winning or academic papers into viral thread format for a Spanish-speaking and English-speaking retail audience.
credibility_note: Scalbi is a finance communicator and retail investor educator, not an institutional fund manager or academic. His strength is surfacing and popularizing research; his summaries sometimes compress or amplify figures in ways that diverge from the source papers (see the '$28 trillion' claim in his Gayed/Bilello thread). Readers should verify key numbers against primary sources before acting on them.
